newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: YIELD RISES TO 5.76 PCT ON BAHRAIN 91-DAY T-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: YIELD RISES TO 5.76 PCT ON BAHRAIN 91-DAY T-BILLS.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of Bahrain 91-day treasury bills climbed to 5.76 percent from 5.73 percent a week earlier, the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price was down to 98.564 dinars from 98.572 last week while the minimum price accepted was 98.553 dinars.
Banks submitted bids for 18.6 million dinars worth of bills, up from 14.85 million dinars last week.
The bills, maturing on November 12, were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday. -- Bahrain newsroom +973-524424
